scenario: Capture-free regex in `where` fires correctly at runtime per LREG.2.1. Assert a Log with msg matching /^ERROR:/ and one that doesn't. Only the matching rule fires.
rules_ds:
schema Log scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    msg: String mutable

rule error_log:
    Log e where e.msg ~ /^ERROR:/
->
    log info "error found"
